evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Joanna: 'May I have the name on the profile?' Customer: 'Debbie Willis.' Later Joanna uses it: 'Thank you so much Debbie,' 'Good Debbie' throughout.
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Joanna: 'with this move, I just need to ask you some questions about it might take about ten to fifteen minutes if this is a good time?' — time-boxed but no promise of dependable quote and no clear wait for yes before continuing.
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Joanna asks 'aside from the pricing, do you have any other important concerns that you also want to discuss on this call?' which is open-ended but not the two-concerns framing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Not applicable — customer raised scheduling availability as primary issue, not a concern in the rubric sense. No probing into underlying concerns.
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: Joanna mentions 'no worries damage coverage. Which would give you up to $2,000 coverage for any accidental damages' and 'on time guarantee if we run late, we provide discounts for the move.' No lead-in permission ask. One-time window; both promised but no permission structure.
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening_and_logistics: Joanna asks about oversized items: 'Aside from the smoker do you have any other item that's oversize like a weight of a piano workout equipment, or a safe?' Gathers two-story to one-story, square footage (3300), bedroom furniture detail, garage items, oversized heavy items (China cabinet, antique armoire, antique sewing machine), glass items, parking/loading options, boxes (about 100), packing status. Comprehensive detail gathering with concern-led framing.
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Joanna: 'Are you planning to get help for packing boxes as well or you're planning to do the packing yourself?' Customer answers will pack everything. Joanna: 'typically for a house this size...usually a house the size we have about $150 to 200 boxes in total. Do you think you would have that many boxes?' Customer indicates ~70 by move time plus Christmas tubs; Joanna settles on 'around a hundred.'
evidence_quotes.value_days: Call routes to walkthrough; not scored.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Call routes to walkthrough; not scored.

top_strength: Joanna gathered comprehensive logistics details through concern-led probing (oversized items, glass, parking, boxes, house configuration) and successfully routed the customer to a virtual walkthrough as the appropriate next step for a large move.
coaching_note: Joanna must ask the primary two-concerns question (on-time vs. damage) early in step 2 and deliver both promises with explicit permission lead-in in step 3 before moving to probing — these are required on all calls including walkthrough routes.
